subject: RFP: vendor replacement + pricing / Redwood proposal requests
messages:
From: Eleanor Smith <e.smith@rivalstack.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-12 09:12 -0700
Subject: Evaluating replacements — can Redwood match pricing?

Hi Rohan,

We’re mid-evaluation for a migration off VendorX and have a pricing/packaging comparison RFP attached. Key things procurement flagged: unit price for hosted inference, committed-reserved discounts for dedicated pools, and any migration credits you can offer. VendorX has offered a 15% discount + a 3-month migration credit; they also bundled an observability add-on at a reduced rate.

Would Redwood be willing to provide a price-match or an alternative package that makes a migration compelling? We’re hoping to decide in the next two weeks.

Attach: RivalStack_RFP.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

—
Eleanor Smith
Head of Cloud Ops, RivalStack
e.smith@rivalstack.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Smith <e.smith@rivalstack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-12 11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluating replacements — can Redwood match pricing?

Hi Eleanor —

Thanks for the RFP. I reviewed it quickly with product and we can definitely be competitive on unit cost and more aggressive on migration economics than VendorX. To make the proposal precise, can you confirm:

- Current avg monthly tokens and peak QPS (30-day)
- Percentage of traffic that needs dedicated vs. hosted
- Any required SLAs beyond 99.9% uptime (latency SLOs, region requirements)

Tentative offer — subject to usage profile: 12-month commitment with 18% list discount on hosted tokens, option to convert to a Dedicated reserved pool with an additional 10% commitment discount, plus a 3-month migration credit (tokens equivalent) or a $60k one-time migration credit, whichever is preferred. We’ll also include the Redwood Console observability bundle at 50% off for the first year.

I’ll get you a written proposal by EOD tomorrow if you can share the usage details. If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute scoping call this week — Marissa and Jonas will join.

Best,
Rohan
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-13 09:30 -0700
Subject: internal: pricing approach for RivalStack (draft)

Rohan / Jonas — quick internal note before we finalize the external doc.

Notes / playbook:
- VendorX is aggressive on list price but bundling observability; their headline 15% may be conditional on a multi-year commit.
- Objective: win the PoC + 12-month commit. Use migration credit as the lever instead of deeper list discounts to preserve ASP.
- Offer: 18% off hosted list OR match VendorX headline + migration credit (cap $75k). If they want Dedicated, default to: 12-month reserve = 25% off list for GPU pools (requires min spend $X).
- Approve an exceptions bucket: Sales Ops pre-authorized up to 20% discount; anything deeper needs CS/Finance sign-off.
- Add line item for a free one-week pilot on a Dedicated node for performance validation. That’s low cost for us but high signal for them.

Attachments for external: redwood_proposal_RivalStack_v1.pdf, competitive_matrix.xlsx

Marissa
VP Sales — Enterprise
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Smith <e.smith@rivalstack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-13 15:20 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal for RivalStack — price & migration options

Eleanor —

Thanks for the details earlier. Attached is our proposal and a short competitive matrix that highlights latency / cost tradeoffs versus VendorX. High level:

- Hosted: 18% off list for 12 months (pay-as-you-go), then revert to list pricing; included token caching optimizations that typically reduce billable tokens by ~8-12% depending on prompt patterns.
- Dedicated: 25% off reserved GPU pools for a 12-month commitment (min spend required). Option to trial a Dedicated node free for 7 days for performance validation.
- Migration credit: choose either 3 months of token credit (applied to hosted bill) or a $60k one-time credit for migration services. Cap: $75k; if you need a higher migration package we can escalate for approval.
- Observability bundle: 50% off first year (full Console access + eval prompts + onboarding support).

We’ve left the contract flexible on data residency and can include a commensurate SOC2 evidence package. DocuSign link included for a standard 12-month commitment; we can draw up an amendment for Dedicated conversion.

Attach: redwood_proposal_RivalStack_v1.pdf (application/pdf), competitive_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Links: https://docusign.net/r/RSK-2025-058

Best,
Rohan
From: Eleanor Smith <e.smith@rivalstack.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-14 10:48 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal for RivalStack — price & migration options

Thanks Rohan — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifying Qs from procurement & infra:

1) The VendorX offer ties the 15% discount to a 24-month commit. If we do 12 months with Redwood at 18% and then convert, what’s the renewal uplift we should expect?
2) For Dedicated, can you confirm the baseline GPU type and whether we can swap regions mid-term without penalty?
3) Migration credit — would Redwood cover ingestion/mapping work from VendorX format to Redwood’s input schema, or is that professional services separately quoted?

We like the trial Dedicated node idea. Also curious: does Redwood offer any short-term commercial protection if VendorX counters with a better headline price?

On timing — we have a procurement decision deadline 2025-10-24. Hoping to close next week if terms are aligned.

—
Eleanor
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-15 08:15 -0700
Subject: internal: approved negotiation plan for RivalStack (final)

Rohan / Jonas — final approved guidance from Sales Leadership and Finance:

- Approve external offer as drafted: 18% for 12 months or match VendorX headline + migration credit up to $75k.
- For renewals: standard escalation is +6% list on renewal after promotional period unless they sign a new committed term; exceptions can be discussed for multi-year conversions.
- Dedicated specifics: baseline is an A100-equivalent GPU pool; region swap allowed once per 12-month term with a small reprovisioning fee (to cover data transfer / reallocation).
- Migration services: we will cover basic ingestion/mapping up to 80 engineer-hours as part of the migration credit; anything beyond will be quoted as professional services.
- Competitive protection: Sales Ops will honor a 7-day price-protection window from proposal date if VendorX returns a counter.

Please update the DocuSign with the 18% EOM special and the migration credit clause, then send to Eleanor. Copy Sales Ops for the 7-day price-protection note.

Marissa
VP Sales — Enterprise
